records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01' AND oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(oi.sales),0),2) AS profit_margin_pct, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.sales IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_sales_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       SUM(oi.quantity) AS qty
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       COUNT(*) AS items
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014' AND i.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter;

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS yr, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) IN ('2013','2014')
GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2)  AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit) / SUM(i.sales) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL AND i.profit IS NOT NULL AND i.sales <> 0
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY SUM(i.profit) / SUM(i.sales) DESC

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 1.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL AND oi.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin ASC

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(order_sales), 2) AS avg_order_amount,
       ROUND(SUM(order_sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.sales) AS order_sales
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate'
    AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)

records.question: 2014 年按月的利润趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS profit,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit) / NULLIF(SUM(i.sales), 0) * 100, 2) AS margin_pct
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit) / SUM(i.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL AND i.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY g.market
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC;

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS 子类,
       COUNT(*) AS 明细行数,
       ROUND(AVG(i.profit), 2) AS 平均利润,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS 总利润,
       ROUND(AVG(i.sales), 2) AS 平均销售额
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.profit IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY 平均利润 ASC

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(i.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC
